name: fripoker
description: LAN Texas Hold'em for coffee breaks

scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.build:server: tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && cp scripts/start.sh dist/start.sh && chmod +x dist/start.sh
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --noEmit && vue-tsc -p tsconfig.client.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
